kyoto_eau_de_vie_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Western set lunches with quiche, bread, cream croquettes, hamburg steak with demi-glace and spring rolls; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_eau_de_vie_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Ratatouille and salads appear among the appetisers, but courses centre on meat, fish, egg quiche and cream sauces (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_eau_de_vie_pontocho.hours_raw: Tuesday 17:30–24:00; Wednesday to Saturday and holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–24:00; Sunday 12:00–15:00 and 17:30–1:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Lunch is a set course only (April 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 3.25% fee for e-money payments (Tabelog). 24 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Third floor of 先斗町92ビル on the west side of Pontocho, south of Sanjo and the Kaburenjo; easy to walk past; 5 min walk from Sanjo Stn (Keihan) (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_eau_de_vie_pontocho.notes: [Yoshoku · Pontocho, a couple's Western kitchen upstairs] A bright third-floor dining bar on Pontocho, run by a husband and wife for some 35 years, that turns out careful Western home cooking: a lunch course under ¥2,000–3,000 with quiche, ratatouille, soup and a hamburg steak or wagyu, and a dinner of about ten small dishes with wine for well under ¥8,000. Open late as a bar. One October 2025 diner found the husband curt and unfriendly while the wife was charming. Closed Monday.

roles: A married couple (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: "run by a husband and wife team" (May 2026), "a couple" (October 2025, October 2026); an October 2026 reviewer says it has been around for 35 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch course; quiche; hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: "At the end, we even had coffee included, all for around JPY 2000, which felt like a great deal." — February 2026.

An October 2025 lunch guest found the husband unfriendly — speaking sharply to the wife during the rush and not answering a thank-you — while the wife left a very good impression; the food was delicious.
"It's easy to see why this restaurant has been around for 35 years, and I highly recommend it!" — October 2026.

kyoto_aoi_obanzai.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai simmered in dashi and soy, fried dishes such as ebi-imo kara-age, croquette-style dishes, pasta and shrimp cream rice; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aoi_obanzai.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: obanzai and dishes with dashi, fish (sea bream, herring, sardines), pork, duck and shrimp (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_aoi_obanzai.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00; closed Monday and some Sundays (Tabelog). Book ahead — a week ahead for a Saturday, with sittings at 17:30 or 20:30 (January 2026); last bookings around 21:00 even on weekdays (June 2026). 11 seats: 6 at the counter, 1 table; non-smoking (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). Ground floor of ニュー京都ビル by Kiyamachi, north of Shijo (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened 24 January 2013 (Tabelog).
kyoto_aoi_obanzai.notes: [Obanzai · Kiyamachi, a cheerful owner's counter] A tiny obanzai counter by Kiyamachi — six seats and one table — where a lively owner with a strong Kyoto accent and the staff serve the day's home cooking from bowls on the counter: shinoda rolls, fried ebi-imo, sea bream with turnip, yuba and shima-aji sashimi, and shrimp cream rice to finish. Dishes run ¥580–1,080 and come generous. Popular with solo diners and visitors from abroad, and featured in guidebooks and on TV — book ahead. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (a woman, unnamed) and staff
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 January 2013 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a cheerful owner with a strong Kyoto dialect who recommends dishes and manages a busy room, many regulars and solo diners, international tourists, a guidebook feature and a TV crew filming in October 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Shinoda-maki; ebi-imo kara-age; yuba sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "This time, there was a TV crew filming, and I nervously participated in an interview (laughs)." — October 2026.
A first-timer in August 2026 let the owner recommend dishes, ordered every suggestion, and found each one a hit — the yuba sashimi twice.
"It's a popular spot frequented by many international tourists, making reservations a must." — September 2025.

kyoto_yoshiya_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo à la carte with ankake, dengaku, fried guji, kara-age, fried shrimp and kamameshi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yoshiya_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based ankake and kamameshi with chicken, oysters or anago; fish, eel and duck dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yoshiya_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations essential — "you cannot enter without a reservation" (Tabelog, October 2025); 20:00 is easier at weekends; reserve popular dishes such as fried guji with the table (December 2025; March 2026). Dress smart-casual — no flip-flops or gym clothes (Tabelog). Tabelog’s service-charge field reads なし (none) in the original. 28 seats: a 10-seat counter, a raised area for 4 and a tatami room upstairs for up to about 12 (Tabelog; September 2025). Cards (VISA, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). An old townhouse on Pontocho south of Sanjo; a second shop has opened across the street (Tabelog); 8 min from Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yoshiya_pontocho.notes: [Kappo · Pontocho, kamameshi in an old townhouse] A long-loved Pontocho kappo in an old townhouse — counter downstairs, tatami room up — where you order Kyoto dishes à la carte: crisp-scaled fried guji, eel Yawata-maki, dashimaki, duck manjū, vegetable ankake, and the house's famous iron-pot kamameshi to finish (oyster in winter, anago in summer). Popular dishes sell out, so reserve them with the table, and book well ahead; 20:00 is easier at weekends. Smart casual. Closed Monday. A second shop has opened across the street.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: very popular, no entry without a reservation (October 2025); a second shop has opened across the street; known for the kamameshi. Long-time regulars in 2025–2026 describe a historic building, a counter on the ground floor and a tatami room upstairs, and staff flexible with orders.
chef_bio.specialty: Kamameshi; fried guji; Yawata-maki.

anecdotes.text: "I made sure to reserve the fried guji fish and Yawata roll, which I absolutely wanted to try." — December 2025.
"I recommend going at 8 PM on weekends, as it’s relatively easier to secure a reservation." — March 2026.
"There was a little mix-up with the fried items not being ordered, but it was all in good fun. I appreciated how flexible they were" — May 2026.

kyoto_gion_okada.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kappo à la carte or omakase: sashimi, vinegared and simmered dishes, fried fish and fugu, tempura, sushi and porridge; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okada.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred kappo of sashimi, crab, fugu, whale and dashi dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_okada.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations from two months ahead (Tabelog); same-day bookings sometimes possible (August 2025). Courses (omakase) or à la carte from a long menu (2025–2026 reviews). 5% service charge (Tabelog). 25 seats with a counter, tatami and a private room for 8 upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) (Tabelog). On Hanamikoji in Gion, south of Shijo (July 2025).
kyoto_gion_okada.notes: [Kappo · Gion Hanamikoji, Kyoto cuisine à la carte] A Gion Kyoto-cuisine house on Hanamikoji that lets you order from a menu longer than most izakaya's — hairy crab, fugu shirako, whale with mizuna, mackerel sushi, corn tempura — or take the omakase, finishing with rice porridge. Quality is high and so are prices (about ¥20,000–30,000), with 5% service. Book up to two months ahead. Some 2025–2026 diners found service slow on busy nights. Open until midnight; closed Sunday and holidays.

roles: Chef and staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2025–2026 call it a famous Gion kaiseki house, mention a Michelin Guide listing (June 2026), praise the à la carte menu and the presentation, and note that service was slow at year-end (December 2025) and only average (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: À la carte Kyoto cuisine; mackerel sushi.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular, told the house was full three weeks ahead, was squeezed in until 18:30 after a Kabuki matinee, and took mackerel sushi home for a son minding the family dog.
"It seems to have more choices than your average inexpensive izakaya, yet the quality of everything is high." — July 2025.
"While I understand that delays are inevitable, the service was really slow... Waiting 20 minutes for the bill was tough." — December 2025.
"The saba sushi was outstanding—I ended up ordering it three times!" — April 2026.

kyoto_gion_yorozuya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon in a soy-seasoned dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yorozuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is kombu and bonito dashi, and toppings include duck, chicken and egg (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yorozuya.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 12:30–15:00 and 17:30–19:00 (last order 18:40); Sunday and holidays 12:30–15:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). No reservations; queues are common — waits of an hour to 1 h 20 min in October and November 2026, none at quiet times (June–August 2026). No shared tables: 14 seats at three tables for four and one for two; single diners get a table for four (Tabelog; October 2026). Some rice bowls are not served every day (November 2026). Cash only; non-smoking; a "no mobile phones" sign on the tables, photos allowed (Tabelog). Wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On a narrow back street that cars use as a shortcut — take care while queuing — between Hanamikoji and Kennin-ji; 3 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_gion_yorozuya.notes: [Udon · Gion, a mountain of Kujo negi] A small udon shop on a Gion back street near Kennin-ji, its walls hung with fans bearing maiko names, known for one bowl: negi udon (¥1,500), soft Kyoto noodles under a heap of Kujo negi in a bonito dashi, sharpened with grated ginger. Kitsune udon and rice bowls such as oyako-don are the alternatives. No bookings and no shared tables, so expect a queue — up to an hour or more in autumn 2026. Cash only; lunch daily, short evenings except Sundays.

roles: Owner (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 mention Michelin recognition (Bib Gourmand or Plate, per different reviewers), appearances on the TBS programme "Jinsei Saikō Restaurant", maiko fans on the walls, and a kind owner (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Negi udon.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived at 12:30 PM and found 8 people ahead of me, which meant I waited about 1 hour and 20 minutes to be seated." — October 2026.
"The owner was very kind and provided excellent service." — August 2026.
A July 2026 diner found the oyako-don a little strongly seasoned.

kyoto_gion_nikuryori_oka.gf_detail: Ask, and tell the restaurant about allergies in advance (Tabelog). The courses include a breaded "Oka katsu", croquettes, pasta and curry alongside charcoal-grilled meat (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nikuryori_oka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef kaiseki of aged and charcoal-grilled meat (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_nikuryori_oka.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday 12:00–15:00, 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; Wednesday and Friday 16:00–18:30 and 19:00–22:30; closed Tuesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only; bookings with an unreachable phone number may be cancelled; allergies in advance (Tabelog). 10% service charge (Tabelog). 8 counter seats facing the grill, with a small garden at the back (Tabelog; September 2024). Staff speak English (September 2026). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In Yayoi alley, Gion south of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_gion_nikuryori_oka.notes: [Meat kaiseki · Gion, aged beef over charcoal] An 8-seat counter in a Gion alley where chef Yoshitaka Oka, a meat griller of over 20 years, cooks aged beef slowly over charcoal and firewood as a kaiseki course: Omi beef tartare laid out like a Kyoto garden, the Chateaubriand 'Oka katsu', and aged steaks from several farms, between soups and seasonal small dishes. Dinner runs about ¥30,000–50,000 a head plus 10% service. Reservation only; closed Tuesday. Aged meat has a distinct aroma — one regular warns it isn't for everyone.

roles: Chef (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): chef Yoshitaka Oka has over 20 years of grilling beef in Gion, butchering bone-in meat and cooking it slowly over charcoal and firewood; guests call the chef the "Meat Griller". A July 2025 reviewer says the restaurant was originally based in Shiga before moving to Kyoto; a March 2025 regular had visited before the relocation. An April 2025 reviewer learned the beef comes from Fukunaga in Shiga.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): meat cooked slowly over a distant fire, which some guests say "doesn’t tire you out."
chef_bio.specialty: Oka katsu; aged-meat steaks.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular, dining with one other guest, found the chef growing more enthusiastic through the evening and grilling extra cuts.
A March 2025 regular notes that aged meat has a distinctive aroma that may be challenging for those not fond of it.
"The service and customer care were good, but I felt it didn’t quite match the price." — September 2026.

kyoto_gibier_miyama.gf_detail: Ask. Game dishes include spring rolls, fried tripe with Parmigiano, quiche, hamburg steak and house bread alongside grilled meats and hot pots; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gibier_miyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat restaurant (venison, wild boar, bear, pheasant, duck) (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gibier_miyama.hours_raw: 17:00–23:30, last seating 21:00, Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday; closed days vary by season; lunch for two or more by reservation (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog); a no-show 15 minutes after the time counts as a cancellation; please avoid strong fragrances (Tabelog). 5% service charge (Tabelog). The meal takes about 3 hours or more (April 2026). 15 seats at a U-shaped counter; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog; March 2026). Gion north of Shijo; 5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog). (お料理 MIYAMA, the casual second shop, is kyoto_oryori_miyama; its record cites an August 2026 reviewer saying Gibier MIYAMA takes no reservations, which conflicts with Tabelog’s "reservation only".)
kyoto_gibier_miyama.notes: [Game · Gion, all the venison and bear you can order] A U-shaped counter in Gion where chef Futa Kanda, from the mountain town of Miyama, serves game: four set dishes, then as many of about 30 à la carte plates as you can manage, for one price (about ¥28,000–32,000 in 2026). Venison tripe, bear pâté, pheasant over charcoal, wild-boar spring rolls and botan-nabe come with Miyama's wild vegetables and house bread; reviewers say the meat has little gamey taste. Allow three hours — one December 2025 diner found service slow and the room cold. Reservation only; closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (April 2026 review; named in お料理 MIYAMA’s Tabelog text)
chef_bio.background: Per an April 2026 reviewer: run by chef Futa Kanda, born in 1989 in Miyama town, Kyoto, cooking seasonal game and wild vegetables from Miyama. Another April 2026 reviewer says the shop works with hunters to secure game and also wholesales it. The Tabelog text of the sister shop お料理 MIYAMA (kyoto_oryori_miyama) names the owner-chef as a RED U-35 Bronze Egg winner and Gibier MIYAMA as nominated for the Tabelog Award 2027.
chef_bio.specialty: Game course with free à la carte.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner found the system slow — à la carte plates were paced with the whole room — and the room too cold, and did not plan to return.
"This restaurant offers all-you-can-eat a la carte, so whether you order one dish or try everything, the price remains the same." — March 2026.
An April 2026 diner was given some of the house bread to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ジビエ料理・イタリアン・イノベーティブ、東山区祇園町北側279-3、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜23:30 (最終入店21:00)、日曜休み、季節により休み、昼は2名以上で予約可、完全予約制、15分連絡がないとキャンセル扱い、強い香水は控えて、サービス料5％、15席、禁煙、カード可。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年7月、英語): Futa Kanda シェフ (1989年生まれ、Miyama 町出身)、最初の4品のあと約30品から食べ放題、コース28,000円・32,340円 (税込)、鹿、猪、熊、雉、鴨、ぼたん鍋、山椒の鍋、Miyama の山菜、自家製パン、ワインセラー、猟師と組んで卸も、提供が遅く寒かったという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; order freely after the first four dishes; no strong perfume; cards accepted.

kyoto_kyoto_ito.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki with dashi and organic soy sauce, French sauces and dairy, tempura and somen; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_kyoto_ito.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the restaurant states it cannot accommodate vegetarian menus because of the nature of its courses (Tabelog, shop text).
kyoto_kyoto_ito.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 and dinner 18:00–21:00, each course starting at a set time; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservation only (Tabelog). 5% service charge, no table charge (Tabelog). Lunch prices rose from October 2026 (September 2026). 16 seats: an 8-seat counter of a single 9 m board, and private rooms for 2–8, including upstairs (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old townhouse behind Shichijo-dori facing the moat of Higashi Hongan-ji; 5 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyoto_ito.notes: [Kaiseki · Kyoto Station, Kyoto–French in an old townhouse] A reservation-only kaiseki in a 100-year-old townhouse across the moat from Higashi Hongan-ji, five minutes from Kyoto Station. Chef Shohei Noguchi, from Fukushima and trained in France and at a sushi shop, mixes dashi, charcoal and rice with French sauces and organic vegetables: corn blancmange with sea urchin, Miwa somen dressed like pasta, ayu kamameshi to finish. Courses start together at 12:00 and 18:00; sit at the 9 m counter or in a private room. Dinner runs about ¥20,000–45,000; one October 2026 diner found it poor value.

roles: Head chef (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 reviewer: head chef Shohei Noguchi is from Fukushima; after culinary school the chef went to France in 2010 to train at a Michelin-starred restaurant, then worked at a Michelin-starred French restaurant in Osaka and trained in sushi at "Fuku Sushi Mori". A June 2026 reviewer says the shop received a Michelin star in 2019 under a different chef and that the current chef was born in 1990, with a young team aged 20s to 30s. Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): organic seasonings such as soy sauce, salt and mirin, and gratitude to producers, fishermen and farmers.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "To Producers, Fishermen, and Farmers: Elevating Gratitude for the Life of Food into Culinary Art."
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal salad; Kyoto–French kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 family booked lunch quickly before a price rise from October, for a father who wanted to return after leaving hospital.
An October 2026 diner praised the staff’s warmth and humour but found the value for money poor for the ingredients.
"In particular, the "Warm Sushi with Fried Sawara Tachi Fish Topped with Sea Urchin" was the most impressive sushi I have ever had in my life." — October 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理、下京区中居町112-1、京都駅より徒歩5分、東本願寺のお堀の向かい、七条通りの裏、昼 12:00〜14:00・夜 18:00〜21:00、不定休、完全予約制、サービス料5％、チャージなし、16席 (カウンター8席、個室2〜8名)、禁煙、カード可、築100年の町家を改装した懐石、京料理とフランス料理、有機の醤油・塩・みりん、名物の季節のサラダ、コースの性質上ベジタリアンメニューは対応不可、Shohei Noguchi 料理長。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): Fukushima 出身、2010年に渡仏、大阪のミシュラン星付きフレンチ、Fuku Sushi Mori で寿司の修業、2019年の星は前の料理長の時、1990年生まれの料理長、若いスタッフ、とうもろこしのブランマンジェ、Miwa の素麺、鱧、Kumamoto のうざく、鮎の釜飯、10月から昼の値上げ、コスパへの不満の声。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; staff explain each dish; many overseas guests (December 2025); cards accepted.

kyoto_kyo_french_kishimoto.gf_detail: Ask. Set courses of hors d’oeuvres, soup, amadai meunière or beef fillet, and dessert; soy sauce is used as a hidden seasoning (official site); no gluten information.
kyoto_kyo_french_kishimoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every course centres on fish meunière or beef fillet, with cream soups and gratins (official site).
kyoto_kyo_french_kishimoto.hours_raw: Official site: lunch 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); closed Tuesday; tables limited to two hours. Tabelog gives dinner L.O. 21:30. Reservations by phone only (official site). Kamo River yuka (riverside terrace) 1 May–30 September, dinner only except lunch in May and September; outside the yuka season a terrace for two a day, with 10% added (official site). Cards (official site: VISA only; Tabelog: VISA, Master, AMEX, Diners) at dinner only — cash at lunch. 16 seats: 10 at the counter, 6 at tables; 16 more on the summer terrace (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Pontocho south of Sanjo, 5 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_french_kishimoto.notes: [French · Pontocho, French with chopsticks above the Kamo River] A long-running Pontocho French restaurant where a chef of more than twenty years in French cooking hides soy sauce in the sauces, serves the beef fillet with fresh wasabi and lays chopsticks on the table. From May to September you can eat on the yuka over the Kamo River at dusk. Courses only: a sea bream meunière or beef fillet at the centre, from ¥4,400 at lunch and ¥6,600 at dinner (more on the yuka). Book by phone; two-hour seating; cash only at lunch; closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: The official site describes cooking from more than twenty years devoted to French cuisine, built on French technique with Kyoto ingredients and seasonings. The yuka stands on a former teahouse’s terrace (official site). A September 2025 regular found the restaurant unchanged as Pontocho changed after the pandemic.
chef_bio.philosophy: A light, easy-to-eat French for all ages, adapted to Kyoto (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef fillet steak with fresh wasabi; amadai meunière.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 regular recalled the chef explaining that soy sauce and other Japanese flavours go into the cooking as a hidden seasoning.
In July 2025, after rain, the chef and staff still let a pair dine on the riverside terrace; the reviewer had chosen French because the companion does not like raw food.
A May 2026 pair on the terrace at 6 p.m. on a Sunday were the only guests on the yuka all evening, while the Pontocho alley outside was full of visitors from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京フレンチ 先斗町きしもと、中京区先斗町三条下ル若松町141番地、昼11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、夜17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、火曜休み、予約は電話のみ、カードは VISA のみ、昼はカード不可、席は2時間まで、鴨川納涼床は5月1日〜9月30日 (5月と9月は昼も)、床の時期以外は1日2名のテラス席 (別途10%)。フレンチ一筋20年余、隠し味に醤油、ステーキにワサビ、鴨に黒七味、箸を添える。夜のコース6,600円〜16,500円、昼4,400円〜11,000円、床のコース7,260円〜18,150円、甘鯛のムニエルか牛フィレ肉。食べログ: 16席 (カウンター10、テーブル6、夏は床16席)、禁煙。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 床で食べるフレンチ、箸で食べる、柔らかいフィレ、デザート3種。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; two-hour seating; cash only at lunch; chopsticks provided.

kyoto_gion_nawate_toriyasu.gf_detail: Ask. The mizutaki is a white chicken-bone broth (seasoned with salt and ginger, per an October 2026 review) eaten with house ponzu; the course also has simmered liver, salt-grilled thigh, and udon or zosui to finish; ponzu and the liver seasoning are not described (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gion_nawate_toriyasu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken house — chicken-bone broth, Tanba chicken, liver (official site).
kyoto_gion_nawate_toriyasu.hours_raw: Official site: 17:00–22:00, last entry 21:00; closed Monday and Thursday. Tabelog asks for entry by 20:30. Reopened on 1 March 2026 after a long closure, with fewer seats and mainly by reservation (official notice, 21 February 2026). Reservations online or by phone; changes by the day before (Tabelog). Prices include tax and service (official site). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 15 seats with a counter, tatami rooms for 2 and 4; the upstairs tatami room has tables and chairs (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children welcome (Tabelog). On Nawate in Gion, 3 min from Gion-Shijo and Sanjo Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_nawate_toriyasu.notes: [Mizutaki · Gion Nawate, seventy years of white chicken broth] A Gion house that has served one thing since 1955: mizutaki, Tanba chicken in a milky chicken-bone broth simmered for a day with well water from under the shop, dipped in house ponzu and finished as zosui. The ¥11,000 course starts with simmered liver and salt-grilled thigh. It reopened on 1 March 2026 after a long closure, with fewer seats — book ahead. Tatami rooms upstairs have tables and chairs. Closed Monday and Thursday.

roles: Head chef and owner (named only in Japanese on the official site; no reading given)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: founded in 1955 by the previous owner, 岸澤邦夫, in Kawaramachi-Takoyakushi, and moved in 1962 to the present spot on Nawate at Shinbashi in Gion; a white-broth mizutaki specialist ever since. The February 2026 reopening notice is signed 岸澤邦和. An October 2026 diner mentions a head chef and an owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: To keep the taste inherited from the previous owner while staying aware of the times (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mizutaki in white chicken-bone broth.

anecdotes.text: A regular of about twenty years was saddened to hear early in 2026 that the shop would close for a long time, and came back as soon as it reopened.
Asked in July 2025 how much zosui to serve, a diner said half a bowl; the staff answered, "Just enough to float away!"
A June 2025 diner who does not eat liver asked for the liver starter to be swapped, and the kitchen obliged.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ぎをん縄手とり安、東山区弁財天町18、創業七十年の水だき専門店、昭和30年に先代の岸澤邦夫が河原町蛸薬師で開業、昭和37年に祇園縄手新橋へ移転、白い鶏がらスープ、朝びきの京都丹波地鶏、敷地内の井戸の東山の名水で丸一日かけて取るスープ、自家製ポン酢、17:00〜22:00 (入店21:00まで)、月・木休み、特選水だきコース11,000円、特選すき焼きコース9,500円 (税・サ込)、一品料理 (肝だき、もも肉塩焼き、唐揚げ、鴨ロース、雑炊)。2026年2月21日のお知らせ: 3月1日から営業再開、席数を絞り予約中心、署名は岸澤邦和。食べログ: 15席、個室 (2人・4人)、禁煙、カード可、子ども可。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 肝だき、もも肉の塩焼き、水だき、雑炊、果物、70年のスープ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; tax and service included; chairs in the upstairs tatami room.

existence.note: Official site (reopened 1 March 2026); Tabelog reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_niku_ryori_shibuya.gf_detail: Ask. Raw and grilled beef with sauces and mustard, salted grills, stews, a hot pot and tail soup; the sauces are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_niku_ryori_shibuya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef restaurant — raw tongue, heart, yukhoe, tripe, grilled cuts, tail soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_niku_ryori_shibuya.hours_raw: 17:00–21:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations only (Tabelog); hard to get through by phone, but callbacks come and same-day bookings sometimes work (March–September 2026). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners; IC cards, iD, QUICPay; no QR (Tabelog). Counter and tatami room; private rooms for 10–20 (Tabelog); about ten guests in all (July 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a renovated machiya in a lane off Kawaramachi north of Ebisugawa, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn exit 16 (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 9 June 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_niku_ryori_shibuya.notes: [Beef · Kyoto City Hall, raw tongue and heart in a machiya] A renovated machiya in a lane near City Hall, opened in 2019 by a chef who for many years led the kitchen at Anzan, the old Gion meat restaurant, and runs it with the chef’s daughter. Beef arrives in small plates in menu order — raw tongue, raw heart and yukhoe (¥1,200 each), blanched mino — until a Yanagawa-style dish signals the break; then order freely from the grill: tongue, tripe, loin, tail soup. About ten seats; reservations only, and the phone is busy. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed), formerly head chef at Anzan in Gion
The chef’s daughter, front of house
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s shop note: the chef was head chef for many years at the well-known Anzan in Gion before going independent and opened Niku Ryori Shibuya with the chef’s daughter on 9 June 2019. A March 2026 reviewer describes a skilled chef and a friendly daughter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Not tied to any beef brand; the best quality available each time (Tabelog shop note).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw tongue, raw heart and yukhoe; Yanagawa-style beef.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 diner who could not book Anzan alone came here instead, struggled to get through on the phone, got a callback, and saw why — the phone in front of the counter rang constantly.
An April 2026 solo traveller had the counter alone just after opening on a weekday and found the young proprietress friendly.
A May 2026 solo diner at Golden Week found it tasty but not extraordinary for the price and did not plan to return.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 肉料理 澁谷、牛料理・日本料理、中京区河原町夷川西入一筋目上ル西革堂193-1、京都市役所前駅16番出口から北へ徒歩5分、17:00〜21:00、水曜休み、完全予約制、カード可、電子マネー可、個室 (10〜20人)、禁煙、2019年6月9日オープン。店の紹介: 祇園の名店 Anzan で長く料理長を務めて独立、娘と開業、銘柄にこだわらずその時の最良の牛肉、アラカルト中心でコースも相談可。口コミ (2026年、英語): 生のタン、ハツ、ユッケ各1,200円、湯引きのミノ、サラダ400円、柳川風、焼きミノ2,500円、テールスープ1,000円、町家を改装した店、メニューの右から順に出てくる独特の注文の仕方。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only, by phone (keep trying); a set ordering rule; raw beef dishes.

kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled vegetables and meat with soy-based sauces such as fermented-butter soy and dashi soy; yuba tempura and fries on the menu; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Many vegetable dishes — grilled vegetables, yudofu in a broth of nine vegetables, nine small dishes at breakfast — but sauces include dashi and butter and the meat dishes are many; the kitchen adjusted dishes for a pregnant guest and an onion-averse guest (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo.hours_raw: Breakfast 8:00–12:00 Monday and Thursday–Sunday, in three reserved seatings at 8:00, 9:15 and 10:30 (Tabelog; September 2026); dinner 17:00–23:00 daily; charcoal-grill orders by 22:00 (October 2026); hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Counter around an irori on the first floor, tables on the second (Tabelog; October 2026). Half portions for solo diners on many items (October 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a back lane 4 min from the JR Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (October 2026). Opened 26 March 2025 (Tabelog; Leaf KYOTO).
kyoto_sumizumido_hachijo.notes: [Izakaya · Kyoto Station Hachijo, charcoal and farm vegetables] A few minutes from the Hachijo exit, an irori counter where vegetables from the group’s own farm and partner growers go over binchotan: shiitake with fermented-butter soy, onion with sakura shrimp, a sweet potato with tea, lemon and honey that eats like dessert, then wagyu by weight. Many dishes come in half portions for solo diners. In the morning it turns into a reserved breakfast (¥2,400) of nine small dishes, rice and a vast block of tofu in vegetable broth. Opened 2025.

roles: Operated by the Kyoto izakaya group 五十家 (Isoya), per Leaf KYOTO
chef_bio.background: Leaf KYOTO (a PR article) introduces it as a new concept from the izakaya group 五十家, with irori and charcoal grilling, using vegetables from the group’s own ISO FARM and partner farmers; opened 26 March 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled vegetables; vegetable breakfast with yudofu.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 breakfast guest was startled by the size of the tofu, and loved the broth made from nine vegetables most of all — finishing it with a spoon.
An October 2026 solo traveller wrote it was worth taking the Shinkansen for, praised the half portions, and was walked to the door on leaving.
An October 2026 breakfast guest who noted a dislike of onions at booking found a different dish prepared instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 炭棲堂、居酒屋、南区東九条西山王町12-7、京都駅から305m、月・木〜日 8:00〜12:00 と 17:00〜23:00、火・水 17:00〜23:00、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、禁煙、2025年3月26日オープン。Leaf KYOTO (PR記事): 五十家グループの新業態、自社農園 ISO FARM と提携農家の野菜。口コミ (2026年、英語): 炭火焼き野菜800円、蓮根の猪ミンチのせ、椎茸の発酵バター醤油、国産牛ハラミ150g 2,800円、黒毛和牛内もも200g 3,800円、鰹と野菜のカルパッチョ1,300円、湯豆腐800円、湯葉とオクラの天ぷら950円、朝ごはん2,400円 (小鉢9品、大きな湯豆腐、9種の野菜の出汁)、一人客にハーフサイズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book breakfast seatings ahead; half portions for solo diners; cards and QR accepted.

kyoto_kichi_kichi.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the omurice comes with a house demi-glace and there are cream croquettes (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kichi_kichi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature is an omurice of egg over chicken rice, with cream croquettes and chicken poêlé on the menu (2024–2026 reviews), though Tabelog lists vegetarian options.
kyoto_kichi_kichi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tuesday–Friday 17:00–21:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 12:00–14:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Monday. Reservation only, through the official website; seating is limited to one hour and late arrivals are cancelled (Tabelog). Online booking opens at 9:00 for lunch and 13:00 for dinner and filled within three minutes for a January 2025 diner. 16 seats: 8 at the counter, 8 in booths; non-smoking; children welcome; English menu (Tabelog). Cards, IC and QR payments (Tabelog). Opened 2 December 1978 (Tabelog). Down an alley south of Sanjo between Kiyamachi and Pontocho; 5 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kichi_kichi.notes: [Yoshoku · Kiyamachi-Sanjo, the omurice show] A 16-seat counter yoshoku down an alley near Pontocho, open since 1978, made world-famous by its master's 'Happy Omurice' — the omelette flipped, slit and spread over ketchup rice with a flourish, demi-glace on top, and the room singing along. Omurice ¥3,000 (2026); soup and cream croquettes too. Booking online only, and slots go within minutes; one-hour sittings, mostly overseas guests. One February 2026 diner found ¥3,000 a lot unless you count the show. Closed Monday.

roles: Master (マスター), per the official site
chef_bio.background: The official site names the master as 幸村 元吉 (Motokichi Yukimura) and is titled "オムライスで世界をHappyに!" ("making the world Happy with omurice"), with a fan club, music and overseas omurice events listed in its news. Tabelog: born in Kyoto in 1978 (opening day 2 December 1978), a western-style restaurant pursuing its own style, built on the idea that being able to order what you want, when you want, in the amount you want is the gateway to deliciousness. Reviewers describe videos viewed more than 100 million times, a visit by the King of Malaysia (January 2025) and fame in Taiwan (October 2024).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog: "May the feelings of both the cooks and the diners be in perfect harmony."
chef_bio.specialty: Happy Omurice.

anecdotes.text: "In the end, everyone, including the customers, sang the omurice song together with great enthusiasm!" — June 2024.
A diner who learned omurice from Kichi Kichi’s YouTube saved up and travelled from Nagaoka to eat it — August 2024.
A February 2026 diner, the only Japanese guest, found the ¥3,000 omurice delicious but pricey without the show.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kichikichi.com): ザ・洋食屋・キチキチ、オムライスで世界をHappyに!、マスター (幸村 元吉)、ファンクラブ、音楽のリリース、海外のオムライスイベント、予約ページ。食べログ: 洋食、中京区三条先斗町下ル材木町185-4、火〜金 17:00〜21:00、土日祝 12:00〜14:00・17:00〜21:00、月曜休み、完全予約制 (公式サイトから)、1時間制、遅刻は自動キャンセル、16席 (カウンター8、ボックス8)、禁煙、子供可、英語メニュー、ベジタリアンメニューあり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、1978年12月2日オープン、食べたいときに食べたいものを食べたい量だけ注文できることが美味しさの入口。口コミ (2021年3月〜2026年2月、英語): オムライス2,700円 (2021年)・3,000円 (2026年)、マスターのパフォーマンス、デミグラスソース、クリームコロッケ、チキンのポワレ、オムライスの歌、ネット予約は昼9時・夜13時開始で数分で満席、海外からの客が多い。

kyoto_cantina_arco.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information; pasta, bruschetta, croquettes and fried cutlets are central, beside carpaccio, caprese and fish dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_arco.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but most dishes use cheese (braided mozzarella), cured meat, anchovy colatura or fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_arco.hours_raw: Tabelog: 14:00–16:30 (last order 16:30) and 18:00–0:30 (last order 0:30); closed Wednesday and one longer break a month. Bookings taken, by phone for parties of 13 or more and for the sharing course; often full, so book (2026 reviews). Sharing course ¥6,000 for groups (3 antipasti, 2 pastas, main, mini dessert; May 2026). 40 seats with counter and tables, one private room for 4, private hire 20–50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; sommelier (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money (Tabelog). Opened 20 October 2014 (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the 洋燈館 west of Takoyakushi-Fuyacho; 5 min walk from Kawaramachi or Karasuma stations (Tabelog; 2017 review).
kyoto_cantina_arco.notes: [Italian · Takoyakushi-Fuyacho, a Sicilian-minded trattoria] A 40-seat trattoria in an old building west of Takoyakushi-Fuyacho, open from afternoon until after midnight: braided buffalo-mozzarella caprese, carpaccio with house colatura, Sicilian sardine-and-pine-nut spaghetti, lemon pasta, crisp cutlets and decanted Italian wine. Courses for groups at ¥6,000; most come à la carte. Busy in the evenings — book. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed) with training in Italy, per a May 2026 review
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe an Italian inspired by southern-Italian taverns, run by an owner-chef with training experience in Italy (May 2026); a June 2026 diner heard the owner-chef had worked at Antico in Ichijoji, and another praised the female owner. Tabelog gives the opening day as 20 October 2014. A 2017 diner already singled out the braided buffalo mozzarella as rare in Japan.
chef_bio.specialty: Treccia caprese; sardine and pine-nut spaghetti.

anecdotes.text: "They don’t use any strange seasonings, and you can really taste the natural flavors of the organic ingredients." — June 2026.
An August 2026 diner who came without the phone-only course was steered by the staff through the menu and given a drink at the end anyway.
"I’m glad I could come here just before my training in Italy starts tomorrow." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・バル、中京区油屋町145 洋燈館 1F、14:00〜16:30・18:00〜24:30 (L.O.)、水曜休み、月1回の連休、予約可 (13名以上は電話)、40席、個室 (4名)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙、子連れ・ベビーカー可、ソムリエ、ベジタリアンメニューあり、カード可、電子マネー不可、2014年10月20日オープン。口コミ (2017年4月、2026年5月〜10月、英語): 南イタリアの居酒屋のような店、イタリアで修業したオーナーシェフ、一乗寺のアンティーコ出身、女性のオーナー、トレッチャのカプレーゼ、自家製コラトゥーラのカルパッチョ、自家製からすみ、鰯と松の実のスパゲッティ、レモンのパスタ、ピスタチオのフジッリ、ミートボールのオレキエッテ、カツレツ、アクアパッツァ、6,000円のシェアコース、デキャンタのワイン。

kyoto_sushi_no_kura.gf_detail: Ask when booking: one chef’s-choice course whose ingredients and cooking cannot be changed; allergies and religious restrictions must be raised in advance, not on the day, and the full fee is charged if a guest cannot eat (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_no_kura.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish omakase of small dishes, nigiri, hand rolls and fish-bone miso soup, with no changes to ingredients (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_no_kura.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:00, closed Monday. Reservation only; two-hour seating; 15 minutes late counts as a cancellation; a smaller party on the day is still charged for the booked number (Tabelog). Omakase only, no changes; allergies or religious restrictions must be raised in advance (Tabelog). Courses ¥22,000–24,000; an eel and crab course ¥33,000 (April and September 2026). No service charge except 10% over 31 December–3 January (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; BYO; children only if they can eat the adult course (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Opened 26 March 2024 (Tabelog). EXIT祇園 1F; about 10 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_no_kura.notes: [Sushi · Gion-Higashiyama, Hokkaido fish on red-vinegar rice] An eight-seat counter, opened March 2024 as the Kyoto sister of Sapporo's hard-to-book Sushi no Kura: a single omakase of about seven Hokkaido-led small dishes — herring roe with cream cheese, hairy-crab cream — then ten or so nigiri on mild red-vinegar rice, hand rolls and fish-bone miso soup, for ¥22,000–24,000. The chef speaks English to overseas guests. No changes to the course; reservation only. Tue–Sun evenings.

roles: Head chef (named only in a machine-translated review)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe the shop as a sister of the Sapporo restaurant Sushi no Kura, produced by its chef, with Hokkaido ingredients, red-vinegar rice in Kyoto against rice vinegar in Sapporo (May 2026), and a friendly head chef who speaks English with overseas guests (August 2025; September 2026). A September 2026 review names the producer and the chef at the counter, but only in English translation, so the names are not used here. Tabelog gives the opening day as 26 March 2024.
chef_bio.specialty: Omakase of Hokkaido fish; smoked nodoguro nigiri.

anecdotes.text: "I feel like the chef's English skills are improving more and more, haha." — August 2025.
A March 2026 diner wished the staff were a bit more cheerful.
A diner who visits almost monthly loves the delicately scored squid and the smoked nodoguro, and hopes the "quick drink set" of five small plates returns — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、東山区林下町434 EXIT祇園 1F、火〜日 18:00〜23:00、月曜休み、完全予約制、2時間制、15分以上の遅刻はキャンセル扱い、当日の人数減でも予約人数分を請求、おまかせのみで食材・調理法の変更不可、アレルギーや宗教上の制限は事前に相談、当日の申告は不可、サービス料・チャージなし (年末年始は10%)、カウンター8席、禁煙、持ち込み可、大人と同じコースを食べられない子供は不可、カード可、2024年3月26日オープン。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 札幌の鮨ノ蔵の姉妹店、北海道の食材、京都は赤酢・札幌は米酢、おまかせ22,000〜24,000円、鰻と蟹のコース33,000円、つまみ7品ほど、数の子とクリームチーズ、毛蟹のクリーム、炙りののどぐろ、北海道の雲丹、手巻き、あら汁の味噌汁、大将は英語で会話。

kyoto_gosho_iwasaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the restaurant says it cannot accommodate gluten-free diets and asks such guests not to come (Tabelog).
kyoto_gosho_iwasaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a dashi-based kaiseki of fish, crab, shellfish, duck or beef hot pot; the restaurant cannot accommodate fish, shellfish or mollusc allergies (Tabelog; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_gosho_iwasaki.hours_raw: Tabelog: lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00 (all guests start together), closed Wednesday. Bookings online or by phone; mention allergies when booking; gluten-free diets and fish, shellfish or mollusc allergies cannot be accommodated; cancellation or change on the day is charged in full (Tabelog). Omakase course ¥23,100 (official site); lunch courses ¥11,000–11,500 (2023–2024 reviews). Service charge 5% (Tabelog). 8 seats: 6 at the counter, 2 at a table; non-smoking; school-age children (Tabelog). Cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). The chef works alone (2024–2026 reviews). Just south of Marutamachi-dori; 3 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_gosho_iwasaki.notes: [Kaiseki · south of the Imperial Palace, one chef, eight seats] An eight-seat kaiseki counter near the Imperial Palace where the chef, trained at Wakuden and Gion Maruyama and once head chef at the inn Hiiragiya, cooks and serves alone, never giving a returning guest the same menu: crab in Tosa-vinegar jelly, karasumi mochi, a seasonal soup, hot pot, kamadaki rice. Omakase ¥23,100; Michelin one star (Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025). No gluten-free; no fish or shellfish allergies. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (店主), per the official site
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: drawn to cooking by an elder brother who was a cook, the owner trained at the Kyoto ryotei 和久傳 and 祇園丸山 and served as head chef at the inn 京の宿 柊家, then opened 御所 岩さき near the Imperial Palace in 2007 (Heisei 19); following the inn custom of changing the menu for guests staying several nights, the chef never serves the same menu twice; one Michelin star in the Michelin Guide Kyoto Osaka 2025. A 2025 review says the restaurant moved from near Karasuma Oike and reopened here in 2021; reviewers in 2024–2026 note the chef runs everything alone.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "旬に寄り添い、心を満たす" — staying close to the season to satisfy the heart; a once-in-a-lifetime menu each visit.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki omakase; kamadaki rice.

anecdotes.text: An October 2024 guest asked about New Year osechi; the chef said that, working alone, osechi could not be made that year.
"Within four seconds of arriving, crab was served." — April 2025.
A December 2023 guest who booked through another site paid almost ¥5,000 more for the same course than on Tabelog.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (gosho-iwasaki.com): 京都市・丸太町、御所南エリアの日本料理店「御所 岩さき (ごしょ いわさき)」、旬の食材の繊細な会席料理をコースで、京都御所や二条城から徒歩圏内、一期一会の献立 (一度来た客に同じものは出さない)、「旬に寄り添い、心を満たす」、店主 岩崎義則: 料理人の兄の影響で料理人を志す、和久傳・祇園丸山で修業、京の宿 柊家で料理長、平成19年に京都御所近くで独立、旅館のもてなしに倣い同じ献立は出さない、ミシュランガイド京都・大阪2025で一つ星、おまかせコース23,100円 (税込)。食べログ: 日本料理、中京区間之町通丸太町下ル東側大津町660、昼12:00・夜18:00一斉スタート、水曜休み、アレルギーは予約時に、グルテンフリーと魚・甲殻類・軟体類のアレルギーは対応不可、当日のキャンセル・変更は100%、サービス料5%、8席 (カウンター6、テーブル2)、禁煙、小学生以上、カード可。口コミ (2022年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 昼のコース11,000〜11,500円、蟹の土佐酢ジュレ、からすみ餅、鮑、胡麻豆腐の白味噌仕立て、ぐじ、鱧と松茸、鴨や牛ロースの鍋、釜炊きご飯、店主ひとりで営業、2021年に烏丸御池近くから移転。

cultural_comfort.note: Set kaiseki with a single start time; dishes explained clearly for overseas guests (October 2025); book ahead.

kyoto_sichuan_yuan.gf_detail: Ask. Sichuan dishes built on chili oil, bean pastes and sauces, with gyoza, buns, noodles and fried rice; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sichuan_yuan.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly meat and seafood (mapo tofu, twice-cooked pork, chili shrimp); a few vegetable plates such as steamed eggplant with leek and Sichuan pepper sauce and two Sichuan potato salads, but no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sichuan_yuan.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 Tuesday to Saturday (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30); 17:30–21:30 Sunday (last food order 20:30, drinks 21:00); closed Monday (Tabelog; Gurunavi gives Tuesday–Sunday, closed Monday). 10% service charge after 22:00 (Tabelog). Bookings taken; recommended at weekends (August 2026). 19 seats: a counter of 6 facing the kitchen, tables and a 5-seat private room; non-smoking; cards accepted, no e-money or QR (Tabelog); cash and cards (January 2026). Tabelog lists BYO drinks. At the back of the 1st floor of the 鍵屋小路会館, a multi-tenant building on the west side of Fuyacho-dori just south of Takatsuji; look for the door with an upside-down 福 beside a big fridge (Tabelog; September 2026). 10 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 January 2026 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sichuan_yuan.notes: [Sichuan · Fuyacho, a new hidden Sichuan kitchen] A 19-seat Sichuan restaurant at the far end of the ground floor of a multi-tenant building on Fuyacho-dori, opened in January 2026 by chef Keiichi Hara, who trained at well-known restaurants and in China per an opening-day reviewer. Order à la carte: a six-item appetizer plate, mapo tofu, a celery-and-bitter-melon chili shrimp, black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork on the bone and crab fried rice, with Shaoxing-wine sodas — numbing and hot but refined, say reviewers; solo diners are offered half portions. Most spend ¥6,000–8,000. Closed Monday.

roles: Chef (named in a January 2026 review); a September 2026 reviewer calls the chef the owner
chef_bio.background: Per a January 2026 opening-day reviewer: chef Keiichi Hara trained at renowned restaurants and in China before opening this Sichuan restaurant, which mixes traditional flavours with a modern sensibility. Another January 2026 reviewer came because a favourite chef had opened a shop and enjoyed this chef’s Sichuan cooking again after a long time. A September 2026 diner found three people running the room and an open kitchen. Opened 21 January 2026 (Tabelog). Name written only in Latin letters in the source.
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; Yuan-style chili shrimp; black-vinegar pork on the bone.

anecdotes.text: An opening-day reviewer in January 2026 found many congratulatory flowers from well-known food lovers at the door and only one seat left.
An August 2026 regular watched the staff help a family of tourists from abroad who were in trouble, speaking fluently and kindly.
A September 2026 diner who disliked century egg was assured the century-egg white tofu would suit even people who dislike it, and was won over.
A September 2026 solo diner found the owner tough-looking at first but gentle when talking, explaining Chinese cooking and serving half portions.

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead at weekends; the shop is at the back of a building and hard to find on the map; 10% service after 22:00.

kyoto_bistro_maumu.gf_detail: Ask. A bistro menu of croquettes, fritters, gratin soup, pasta, gnocchi and bread; a few plates such as carpaccio, burrata with fruit and steak may suit, but no gluten information is published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_maumu.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; the menu is mostly meat, fish, cheese and egg, with a tofu-and-tomato caprese and truffle-mayo fries among the few meat-free plates (Tabelog; official menu).
kyoto_bistro_maumu.hours_raw: 17:00–1:30 (official site); Tabelog gives 17:00–1:00 Monday, Tuesday and Thursday to Sunday and holidays, 17:00–23:00 Wednesday; a September 2026 review gives 17:00–25:00 (Wednesday to 23:00) and irregular closures. Bookings taken; include the date and message when booking a celebration cake (Tabelog). 25 seats: a wooden counter round the kitchen on the 1st floor and about seven tables for two on the 2nd (Tabelog; September 2026); non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus; staff and chef speak English (Tabelog; October 2026). Green door down a small alley on Ayakoji west of Yanaginobamba; 2 min from Hankyu Karasuma Stn exit 15 (Tabelog). Opened 31 May 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_maumu.notes: [French bistro · Karasuma, a late-night wine bistro] A two-floor bistro behind a green door in an alley off Ayakoji, styled on Paris back streets, with a wooden counter round the kitchen downstairs and small tables upstairs. The menu sticks to bistro classics — steak frites, French onion gratin soup, pâté, crab croquettes — plus burrata with whatever fruit is in season, a torched-cheese Bolognese and Parmesan gnocchi, with wines picked by the sommelier. Reviewers like the late hours and the English-speaking staff; one solo diner was given a smaller pasta portion. Open until 1:30 (to 23:00 on Wednesday).

roles: Operator 株式会社ＧＭＩ (Gion; invoice T6130001067887), which also runs 焼肉マウム and 居酒屋 マウム; chef not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: Bistro Maumu does not chase trends and loves the unchanging scene of Paris bistros — steak frites, a daily pasta, honest food at the end of the day — with a resident sommelier choosing classic French and Italian bottles and New World wines. Opened 31 May 2024 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社ＧＭＩ, whose head office is at the 焼肉マウム address in Gion (NTA corporate-number site; Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "We make food that makes people happy" — a place to reset after work, not a special place you visit stiffly.
chef_bio.specialty: Steak frites; burrata with seasonal fruit; Parmesan-cream gnocchi.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 solo diner was given a smaller pasta portion by the chef, with an offer to add more if it was not enough.
Staff told an October 2026 diner that the team has visited the Hokkaido oyster area three times.

kyoto_torinoki_coffee.notes: [Café · Ebisugawa, pudding and hand-drip coffee] An eleven-seat coffee house on Ebisugawa-dori south of the Imperial Palace, all warm wood, antique-style lamps, a bookshelf and mismatched cups. kyoto_linamha_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Mostly wagyu, pork, chicken and seafood; a vegetable bibimbap, namul and seasonal vegetable plates are on the menu, but no ingredient list is published (official menu).
kyoto_linamha_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 Monday to Friday; 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (last orders 14:00 and 22:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Courses need booking ahead (official site). 10% service charge; private rooms for 4–6 cost an extra ¥6,000 (¥6,000–8,000 on the course page) (official site; Tabelog). 50 seats: a counter round the kitchen, tables on the 2nd floor facing the Kamo River and private rooms facing Pontocho (official site; August–September 2026); non-smoking; cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog). On Pontocho north of Shijo; 2 min from Gion-Shijo or Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Kyoto shop opened July 2009 in a renovated old house in a Pontocho back alley, later moved to the riverside within Pontocho (operator site; official site).
kyoto_linamha_pontocho.notes: [Korean · Pontocho, wagyu and kimchi over the Kamo River] The Kyoto branch of an Osaka-born chef's Korean restaurant that began in Daikanyama in 2000, here since 2009 and now in a stone-and-wood building on Pontocho with a counter round the kitchen and second-floor tables over the Kamo River. Courses open with a seasonal porridge and the house kimchi, then chijimi of Kyoto Kujo-negi, japchae and a main such as dakhanmari, bulgogi hot pot or black-pork samgyeopsal (¥7,000–12,000); à la carte runs to wagyu by the gram and bossam kimchi with seasonal fruit. 10% service. Tabelog Asian/Ethnic WEST 'Tabelog 100' 2026.

roles: Owner-chef of the operator group (grate-ful.co.jp); the shop carries the chef’s own name
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: in 2000 the Osaka-born cook 李 南河 opened 代官山 李南河 in Tokyo, naming it after the chef in the hope that guests feel as if eating at home; the Kyoto sister shop opened in a renovated old house in a Pontocho back alley and later moved to the riverside within Pontocho; the owner-chef visits producers and markets and buys wagyu at the Kyoto meat market; selected by ZAGAT and as a best Korean restaurant by the Korean Food Foundation; the bulgogi shop SURAGAN (Ebisu) followed in 2005. The operator グレイトフル株式会社 lists 9 restaurants and delis in Tokyo, Kanagawa and Kyoto, two named 李南河, and dates the Kyoto opening to July 2009 (grate-ful.co.jp). The invoice holder is the group company グレイトフルオペレーション株式会社 (Tabelog; NTA).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to keep trying new things with carefully chosen seasonal ingredients so people learn how good Korean food is.
chef_bio.specialty: Bossam kimchi with seasonal fruit; Kujo-negi chijimi; dakhanmari and bulgogi hot pots.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 host whose guest disliked green onion was given seafood chijimi in place of the Kujo-negi one at no extra charge; the private room faced Pontocho, not the river.

A September 2026 regular plans to come back every two months, finishing with fig compote and vanilla ice cream.

kyoto_restaurant_koga.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00 (last order 13:00); dinner 18:00 (last order 19:30 — the site gives 19:00 in one place); closed Tuesday and Wednesday, with some special openings (official site; Tabelog). kyoto_restaurant_koga.notes: [French · Ogawa-dori near the Imperial Palace, Michelin one star per reviewers] Chef 古賀 隆稚 (Koga Ryuji) — once deputy head chef at Le Cinq in Paris and later head chef at the Four Seasons Hotel Kyoto — opened this French restaurant in a renovated machiya in 2025. Omakase only: lunch ¥12,000, dinner ¥22,000, plus 10%. English menu and staff; no vegan or vegetarian meals. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

roles: Chef
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: after École Tsuji's school in France and training in regional France, worked from 2006 at Joël Robuchon (Ebisu), then in France at Le Chabichou (Courchevel), Villa Archange (Cannes), Ledoyen (Paris) and as sous-chef at a one-star restaurant; from 2016 the first Japanese deputy head chef, also developing menus, at Le Cinq (Hôtel George V, Paris) under Christian Le Squer; back in Japan in 2019 as head chef at the Four Seasons Hotel Kyoto. RED U-35 bronze egg 2013 and silver egg 2014 and 2015. Opened KOGA on 9 January 2025 (Tabelog). An October 2026 reviewer writes that it holds one Michelin star in the 2026 Kyoto-Osaka guide.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: a restaurant as a "総合芸術" (total art) of space, service and cuisine; respect for every ingredient and its producer; combining ingredients like a perfumer combines scents.
chef_bio.specialty: Warm salad of 30-plus vegetables; soufflé baked to order.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 return guest asked about each dish and the chef "openly shared everything I was curious about".

kyoto_nishitomiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the draw is breaded, fried croquettes, served with bread at lunch (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishitomiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: croquettes with butter, blue cheese or octopus, and appetizer platters with ham and salmon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nishitomiya.hours_raw: 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00 every day; closing days not fixed; takeaway croquettes from 12:00 until sold out (Tabelog). Lunch can be booked only for 12:00 (Tabelog). Evenings it runs as a bar, so order a drink (June 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; May 2026). 20 seats incl. a counter; non-smoking; on the ground floor of an apartment building — do not wait inside the building or park bicycles there (Tabelog). 5 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_nishitomiya.notes: [Croquettes & wine · Sanjo-Shirakawa] A small bar by the Shirakawa canal built around croquettes fried to order — plain, blue cheese, octopus — with wine. Lunch is two croquettes with a full appetizer platter and bread (¥1,800); evenings are for drinking. Lunch bookings only for 12:00; cash only; takeaway croquettes too.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: A croquette-focused bar listed on Tabelog with reviews from 2024; an October 2026 reviewer came after seeing it on the TV show "Life's Restaurant" with Go Naito.
chef_bio.specialty: Croquettes; blue-cheese croquette.

anecdotes.text: One of two white wines had too much sediment, so the staff suggested a different one — May 2026.
A reviewer got a lunch booking only on the third try: once full, once closed on an evening drop-in — October 2026.
A July 2026 lunch-goer liked the crisp coating but missed having sauce for the croquettes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: NISHITOMIYA、バル・ダイニングバー・コロッケ、東山区西町126 ビスタ三条白川 1F 南側、東山駅から徒歩5分、12:00〜14:00・18:00〜22:00、不定休、テイクアウト12:00〜売り切れまで、ランチの予約は12時のみ、20席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、マンションの1階のため建物内で待たない・自転車を止めない。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年10月、英語): コロッケ (プレーン、ブルーチーズ、奈良漬けとレモンピール、ガリシア風タコ、春キャベツとパルミジャーノ)、前菜盛り合わせとコロッケのランチ1,800円、夜はバーで酒の注文が必要、現金のみ、自然派ワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the 12:00 lunch; cash only; order a drink in the evening.

kyoto_shigure_chaya_wabisuke.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto cuisine with dashi, saikyo-miso grills and simmered dishes; the menu also has tempura, kakiage and a horse-mackerel fry, which are not gluten-free (official site; 2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shigure_chaya_wabisuke.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal fish, dashi-based dishes, chicken, beef and duck (official site).
kyoto_shigure_chaya_wabisuke.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesday; seasonal breaks in summer and winter announced on the site (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). An otoshi charge of ¥1,000 per person (Tabelog). Cards: VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 13 seats: 8 at the counter and one table for 4; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog; official site). Non-smoking (Tabelog). No seating for children (Tabelog). On the Shirakawa stone lane in Gion near Tatsumi Shrine, 4–5 min from Gion-Shijo Stn (official site; Tabelog; December 2024).
kyoto_shigure_chaya_wabisuke.notes: [Kyoto cuisine · Gion Shirakawa, a counter by the stone lane] A tiny counter hidden on the Shirakawa stone lane in Gion, with eight seats in front of the cooks and one table. The nine-course omakase is ¥11,000, or order à la carte from the seasonal list: rolled omelette, karasumi with daikon, salt-grilled Kyoto chicken, saba-zushi to finish, and old-Kyoto drinking snacks such as funazushi and whale bacon. The head chef, named 筒井 on the official site, trained within the yagenbori group. ¥1,000 otoshi; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: 筒井 (head chef; reading not given)
roles: Head chef 筒井, promoted after training at yagenbori (official site)
Operated by the yagenbori group
chef_bio.background: The official site says the head chef, 筒井, was chosen to lead Wabisuke after training at yagenbori, and that the kitchen blends Kyoto tradition with new arrangements. A March 2026 reviewer first came about 35 years ago, when an elderly woman ran it alone; it later joined the yagenbori group, and the chef has changed on each visit since. A February 2026 reviewer says the present head chef has led the kitchen for a few years.
chef_bio.philosophy: To bring out the character of fish from around Kyoto and Kyoto vegetables in Kyoto cuisine that shows the four seasons (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal omakase; karasumi with daikon; saba-zushi.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular of some 35 years noticed the large platters of obanzai once laid along the counter were gone, and was told the change came with COVID-19.
A February 2026 family bonded with the young head chef over baseball at a packed counter.
A 2019 regular who loves teppai mentioned it ahead of time, and the kitchen made it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (やげんぼりグループ): しぐれ茶屋侘助、東山区祇園白川通縄手東入ル、祇園・白川沿いのカウンター中心の小さな店、京都近郊の鮮魚と京野菜の京料理、やげんぼりで修行の後に料理長に抜擢された筒井料理長、おまかせコース9品11,000円、単品 (秋鮭西京焼き、京蕪蒸し1,500円、鯖へしこ、鮒ずし、くじらベーコン、からすみ、合鴨ロース)、季節のおすすめ (京出汁巻き、自家製からすみ、若竹煮、京地どり塩焼き、天ぷら、鯖ずし、じゃこごはん)、お持ち帰りの鯖寿司と角煮、17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、火曜休み、カウンター8席とテーブル1卓。グループの店は花見小路やげんぼり、出逢ひ茶屋おせん、しぐれ茶屋侘助、祇をん う桶や う、花遊小路 江戸川、御二九と八さい はちべー。食べログ: 13席、突き出し1,000円、カード可、禁煙、子ども用の席なし。口コミ (2019〜2026年、英語): 約35年前は年配の女性が一人で営んでいた、その後やげんぼりグループに、料理長は数年ごとに替わる、白川沿い、辰巳神社の近く。

cultural_comfort.note: ¥1,000 otoshi; small counter, book ahead; no seats for children.

kyoto_sumi_kiyamachi_matsubara.gf_detail: Ask. Natural wine, coffee and beer with cheese, salami and canelé; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumi_kiyamachi_matsubara.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine and black coffee; the snacks are cheese, salami and canelé (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumi_kiyamachi_matsubara.hours_raw: 10:00–23:00 daily; closing days may vary (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash-on system: a machine turns a ¥1,000 note into two coins; one coin pours 50, 40 or 25 ml of wine from the self-serve server, depending on the wine (Tabelog; May 2026). Other drinks and snacks ordered from staff (May 2026). Cards: JCB; e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 4 seats: two tables for two and a standing table, plus a few seats outside (Tabelog; September 2025). Bottle shop upstairs (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi just north of Matsubara, next to the soba shop suba, 6 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 6 July 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sumi_kiyamachi_matsubara.notes: [Wine stand · Kiyamachi-Matsubara, natural wine by the coin] A small open-fronted stand on Kiyamachi where you feed ¥1,000 into a machine, get two coins, and pour your own natural wine from the servers — orange, Japanese, Spanish, French — about ¥500 a pour, from 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. Coffee, chai, beer, cheese, salami and canelé come from the counter, and bottles are sold upstairs. A sister of the soba shop next door, suba, so it works well before or after. Mostly standing; one November 2025 visitor found the system unexplained.

roles: Staff (unnamed); same group as the soba shop suba and a yakitori shop (July 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog gives the opening as 6 July 2023. A July 2026 reviewer learned from the staff that it belongs to the same group as suba next door and a yakitori shop; a May 2026 reviewer calls suba the sister restaurant.
chef_bio.specialty: Self-pour natural wine by the coin.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor who had read about ¥500 wine expected to order from staff, then found the machine: a ¥1,000 note, two coins, and the wine pours itself into the glass.
A November 2025 traveller started a Kyoto trip at 10:30 a.m. here and worked through twelve wines.
A November 2025 visitor found nobody explained the system and the staff chatting with someone inside; a neighbouring customer showed how it worked.

kyoto_nanaharu_ebisugawa.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, simmered octopus and a duck hot pot alongside the signature kushiage and tempura, which are not gluten-free; dashi and miso seasonings throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nanaharu_ebisugawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish, duck, pork, dashi-based dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_nanaharu_ebisugawa.hours_raw: 18:00–22:30; closed Wednesday and one irregular day a month (Tabelog). Reservations by phone (online on some days); seating limited to 2 hours 30 minutes; reservations dropped after 30 minutes’ delay without a call (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 19 seats with a counter (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children of school age welcome (Tabelog). On Ebisugawa west of Tominokoji, 8 min from Karasuma-Marutamachi or Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened here 7 September 2024 after moving from Kiyamachi (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_nanaharu_ebisugawa.notes: [Izakaya · Ebisugawa, kushiage and duck hot pot by a couple] A warm, counter-led izakaya run by a couple, which moved in 2024 from Kiyamachi to a quiet stretch of Ebisugawa. Regulars come for the nanakushi — seven creative kushiage (¥2,100) — and the duck and Kujo green-onion hot pot finished as zosui, with sashimi of local fish, bonito shio-tataki and a chirimen-sansho fried rice to close. A good blackboard of sake. Cash only; book by phone; closed Wednesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed) and the chef’s wife, who run it as a couple
chef_bio.background: Reviewers knew it first on Kiyamachi; it moved to Ebisugawa, and Tabelog gives the opening here as 7 September 2024. Several 2026 reviews describe it as run by a couple.
chef_bio.specialty: Nanakushi kushiage; duck and Kujo green-onion hot pot.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 pair, not knowing when a concert would end, called at the last minute and were offered a table for two at 7:30 — and skipped the merchandise stand to make it.
A May 2026 diner arrived just before opening and watched the chef hang out the noren, glad to see the chef’s wife as lively as ever.
An August 2026 visitor returning after five years found the cooking unchanged while so many places were raising prices or cutting corners.

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book by phone; 2 h 30 min seating.

kyoto_sushi_mori_gaku.gf_detail: Ask. Omakase of sushi and small dishes with soy-based seasonings, anago and eel with sauce, and wagyu shabu-shabu; allergies can be raised when booking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_mori_gaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase of fish and seafood, with wagyu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_mori_gaku.hours_raw: Reservations only. Lunch 12:00–14:00; dinner in two seatings that start together, 18:00–20:00 and 20:30–22:30; closed Wednesday (official site; Tabelog). Tell the shop about dislikes, allergies or celebrations when booking (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese listing). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 8 counter seats (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Children and babies welcome, no baby chairs (Tabelog). Set back inside a building on Kiyamachi south of Nijo, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 2 June 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_mori_gaku.notes: [Sushi · Kiyamachi-Nijo, straw-flamed bonito at an eight-seat counter] Down a passage off Kiyamachi, a dark, bar-like counter of eight seats where the owner, with more than thirty years in Japanese cooking, serves omakase from Maizuru fish and beyond. The show is the straw grill: lights down, flames up, bonito seared in front of you; mackerel skin is pressed with live charcoal. About seventeen dishes at dinner, in two seatings that start together; lunch at noon. Reservations only; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed on the official site; an August 2026 review thanks “Master Inoue”)
chef_bio.background: The official site says the owner has more than thirty years of experience across Japanese cuisine, and describes the room as a calm, bar-like hideaway. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 June 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal fish chosen from Maizuru and across Japan, served as omakase at the counter (official site); a May 2026 reviewer noted the focus on origin and season.
chef_bio.specialty: Straw-grilled bonito; charcoal-seared mackerel roll.

anecdotes.text: At a July 2026 lunch the room went dark as the straw caught fire and the bonito was seared inches away — a first for the diner, who already loved katsuo tataki.
A September 2026 diner said it engaged smell and hearing as well as taste, with the scent of straw and the sizzle of charcoal, and a friend from Singapore planned to recommend it.
A June 2026 lunch guest found nothing memorable and was distracted by a server’s constant chatter with other guests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鮨森学、中京区木屋町通二条下る東生洲町489番地、京都舞鶴と全国から厳選した旬のネタ、おまかせコースでカウンターの鮨と一品料理、落ち着いたBARの雰囲気、日本料理全般で30年以上の経験を持つ店主、予約制、昼12:00〜14:00、夜1部18:00〜20:00、2部20:30〜22:30 (一斉スタート)、水曜休み、カード可。食べログ: 8席、サービス料あり、電子マネー・QR可、持ち込み可、禁煙、子ども可、2024年6月2日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夜は約17品のおまかせ、藁焼きの鰹、炭で炙る鯖、炭塩のいか、蒸籠の穴子、和牛のしゃぶしゃぶ、店主の Inoue さん。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservations only, set start times; service charge added; children welcome; guests from abroad common (October 2026).

kyoto_tonchinkan.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, monjayaki, yakisoba and betayaki are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes cooked on shared teppan with sauce (2026 reviews).
kyoto_tonchinkan.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the monjayaki is made with a bonito and kombu dashi and most dishes carry pork, squid or beef tendon (Tabelog; June 2026).
kyoto_tonchinkan.hours_raw: 11:30–22:30 (last order 22:00) daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog); walk-ins found seats on a Saturday afternoon (October 2026). The kitchen cooks the dishes and brings them nearly ready (May–October 2026). Third floor up stairs, no lift (June and August 2026). 44 seats including a tatami room; private hire for 20–50; smoking allowed; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On Rokkaku-dori west of Kawaramachi; 5 min from Sanjo, Kawaramachi and Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stns (Tabelog).
kyoto_tonchinkan.notes: [Okonomiyaki & monja · Kawaramachi, Tokyo-style monja up three flights] A retro, third-floor teppan shop on Rokkaku, cheap for central Kyoto, that has served monjayaki — rare in the city — for two decades or more. Start with a monja of squid, mentaiko and Baby Star (¥850 base), then a mixed okonomiyaki, betayaki or yakisoba (about ¥900–1,200); the kitchen brings them almost ready to finish on your griddle. Portions are modest; one October 2026 diner thought the mixes tasted pre-made. Smoking allowed; no lift. Open daily 11:30–22:30.

roles: Restaurant; no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): open on Kawaramachi for 20 years, serving authentic monjayaki, rare in Kyoto, with a fluffy batter of its own blend, and gives the opening day as 4 March 2000; a September 2026 reviewer gives the founding as 27 years ago. A June 2026 reviewer says the name comes from a nickname given to the mischievous previous owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Monjayaki; okonomiyaki.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner felt dishes arrived pre-prepared rather than off the teppan and suspected frozen mixes, likening the taste to a festival stall.
"The interior may not be the cleanest, but the service is quick, and the dishes come out promptly!" — August 2026.
"By the way, the name "Tonchinkan" comes from a nickname given to the previous owner, who was quite a mischievous character." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き・もんじゃ焼き・居酒屋、中京区河原町通六角西入ル松ケ枝町464 大文字ビル 3F、三条駅・河原町駅・京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、毎日11:30〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可、44席、座敷、貸切20〜50名、喫煙可、カード・PayPay 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、開店日2000年3月4日、河原町で20年、京都では珍しい本格もんじゃ、ふわふわの生地。口コミ (2026年5〜10月、英語): もんじゃ850円 (いか・明太子・Baby Star、すじねぎ、明太もちチーズ)、ミックス焼1,199円、焼そば、ねぎ焼すじ902円、いか玉891円、エレベーターなしの3階、創業27年という声、店名は先代のあだ名、作り置き・冷凍のようだという声、量は少なめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Order from the menu; dishes come ready to finish on the griddle; cards and PayPay; smoking allowed.

kyoto_arbrin_yugen.gf_detail: Ask. The lunch buffet is bread, pasta, quiche-style dishes and desserts alongside salads and vegetables; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_arbrin_yugen.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the buffet is vegetable-led, but it also carries prosciutto, pâté, mussels and cheesecake (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_arbrin_yugen.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–10:30 (last order 10:00), lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:00; buffet until 14:30), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 22:00), daily (Tabelog). Lunch is a buffet with one main dish chosen from 6–8, for 90 minutes; book ahead — online slots fill and the restaurant asks diners not to phone on fully booked days (Tabelog; September–October 2026). No birthday plates at lunch (Tabelog). Dinner charge ¥500; dinner courses need one drink each (Tabelog). 50 seats with an open kitchen; private hire up to 50; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; cards, IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Ground floor of the hotel YUGEN Kyoto Shijo on Takatsuji; 6 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_arbrin_yugen.notes: [French bistro · Kawaramachi, a vegetable-led lunch buffet] The glass-walled restaurant of the hotel YUGEN Kyoto Shijo, with an open kitchen and a lunch formula that fills up: pick one main — Bolognese, carbonara, a steak or onion gratin soup — and help yourself to a buffet of vegetable dishes, prosciutto, pâté, mussels, breads and Basque cheesecake, for 90 minutes. Lunch bills run about ¥2,000–4,000. Breakfast from 7:30 and French dinners with wine too. Book online; one September 2026 diner found the room tight, with staff carrying dishes taking the aisles.

roles: Hotel restaurant; chef unnamed (over 20 years’ experience per Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): a casual French regional restaurant on the first floor of the hotel, with an open kitchen run by a chef of over 20 years, seasonal Kyoto ingredients, and wines from around the world and domestic sake; private hire for up to 50.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch buffet with a main.

kyoto_hongdae_moban.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Another note on the same Tabelog page gives 11:30–22:00 with a break 15:00–17:30. A September 2026 reviewer says lunch is served on weekdays only. Bookings taken, also through Tabelog (Tabelog; September 2025). 11 seats; non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), no e-money or QR (Tabelog). A small fee for takeaway containers (March 2026). On Matsubara-dori east of Fuyacho, near Teramachi; 383 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; February 2025).
kyoto_hongdae_moban.notes: [Korean · Matsubara-dori near Teramachi] An 11-seat Korean café-diner with K-pop on the screens, run by a Korean chef and staff per a 2025 review: bibimbap and chige sets at lunch, then 'UFO chicken' with melted cheese, samgyeopsal, tteokbokki and soju into the night (to 23:00). Lunch about ¥1,200; dinner ¥2,000–4,000. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Chef (unnamed; Korean, per a February 2025 review)
chef_bio.origin: Korea (February 2025 review: "Both the chef and staff are Korean").
chef_bio.background: Opened 24 December 2020 (Tabelog). Per the operator: an interior, music and food meant to take you to Korea, with videos from groups such as TWICE and BTS. A February 2025 reviewer explains the name as Hongdae, the area by Hongik University, plus mokbang, eating videos.
chef_bio.specialty: UFO chicken; bibimbap set.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner who often visits Seoul came with a Korean friend for the bossam course — "a bit small, but absolutely delicious".
Hoping for cold noodles on a hot June 2025 day, a lunch guest found only lunch sets on offer.
A March 2026 diner took leftover chicken home and paid a small fee for the container.

kyoto_jukusei_sashimi_hitoshio.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, dashi-simmered and fried dishes, tempura in the set menus, saikyo-miso grilled cheese; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_jukusei_sashimi_hitoshio.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the house dashi is kombu with bonito flakes, and the menu is built on fish (Tabelog).
kyoto_jukusei_sashimi_hitoshio.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:15); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Online booking except for same-day; the phone may not be answered during service; one drink and one dish per person; tables for groups of three or more (Tabelog). Starter charge ¥500, not with courses; ¥1,500 on 1–3 January (Tabelog). Japanese sake half price on Thursdays (May 2026 review; also June 2023). 18 seats incl. counter rooms for 2–4 facing a courtyard and private rooms; wheelchair accessible; non-smoking; minors generally not admitted — ask for family bookings; cards incl. UnionPay; PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). At Rokkaku and Tominokoji; 8 min from Karasuma, Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae or Karasuma-Oike Stn (Tabelog; December 2024).
kyoto_jukusei_sashimi_hitoshio.notes: [Aged sashimi & sake · Rokkaku-Tominokoji] A stylish izakaya with counter seats around a small courtyard, built on two things: sashimi platters mixing fresh and aged fish, and about 30 sake chosen by the owner — half price on Thursdays, per regulars. Don't miss the saikyo-miso grilled Camembert. Around ¥6,000–8,000; ¥500 starter. Open to 23:00; closed Tuesday.

roles: Owner (unnamed in the sources; chooses the sake)
chef_bio.background: Opened 22 May 2018 (Tabelog). Per the operator: fish sent direct from places such as Maizuru, Iki and Kochi, served fresh and aged; dashi from kombu soaked for a day and simmered four hours, finished with bonito flakes.
chef_bio.specialty: Tsukuri-mori of fresh and aged fish; saikyo-miso grilled Camembert.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 third-timer found the aged sashimi "a matter of personal preference" — creamy, unusual and sweet — and the Thursday half-price sake kept the bill low.
In August 2025 the place was "lively with many international guests", though some dishes a traveller wanted had run out.
A November 2025 diner's one request: fix the wobbly chair legs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 熟成刺身と旨い酒 ひとしお、居酒屋・海鮮・日本酒バー、中京区大黒町88 シルブープレビル 1F、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:15)、火曜休み、お付き出し500円 (コースは不要、元旦から3日は1,500円)、18席、中庭を望むカウンター個室、テーブルは3名から、未成年は原則不可、2018年5月22日オープン、名物つくり盛り (舞鶴、壱岐、高知などからの鮮魚と熟成刺身)、昆布を一日水に浸けて4時間炊き鰹節を合わせる出汁、大根の揚げ出汁、生麩や生湯葉、店主が選ぶ日本酒約30種、京都セット7,700円、鰻蒲焼セット8,800円、黒毛和牛セット9,900円。口コミ (2023年6月〜2026年8月、英語): カマンベールの西京味噌焼き、木曜日は日本酒半額、鱗の唐揚げ、白子、熟成刺身。
